## Sim2Sim: ComFree → MuJoCo {#sec-sim2sim}

Everything above is measured in "reality", i.e. ComFree with perturbed parameters. Sim2sim changes what SysID cannot fix: the contact model. Trained agents are run in stock CPU MuJoCo [@todorov2012mujoco] with the same scene, timestep, reality parameters and task code; only the contact solver differs. The two ComFree contact constants have no MuJoCo equivalent and are dropped. <!-- F:X1 --> The policy is evaluated alone. The planner still plans through ComFree with the run's identified parameters, synced to the MuJoCo state at every step. <!-- F:X2 --> Parameters match between the simulators to about 1e-7 relative error. <!-- F:X3 --> There is still no real robot.

Questions: does the hero agent keep working? Does the hero configuration transfer better at 300k than at 150k, or does longer training overfit to ComFree? Is TD-MPC2 more or less brittle? Does DAgger's safer policy transfer better than rung D's? How far do open-loop trajectories diverge? I only evaluate runs that trained well (planner G ≥ 4.5, drop ≤ 0.05, plus the DAgger policies). Runs that already drop the cube in ComFree leave no gap to measure.
